notes.title: MGCMCE ver2.98 Update Contents
notes.content:
@All
- Fixed an issue that Iroha Asobe appears more frequently in Arcade Mode.
- Added Nemesis as a playable character.
*The story completion illustration is WIP.
- Changed the requirement for the hidden boss to appear to a score of 300,000 or higher.
- Changed the number of times you need to raise your bond to make Nemesis appear among the hidden bosses from 5 to 2.
- Fixed issues that D button skills were possible to cancel from a guard cancel Flux Evasion.

@Iroha
- Melt Attack: Attack level changed to equivalent to a C attack. The hitbox for the first and second hits has been expanded forward. Now delay cancelable. This makes it easier to cancel into various special moves.
- Magi Flame of Justice: Total recovery time increased from 71F to 61F. Guard recovery advantage increased from -6F to +3F. Knockback adjusted. Maximum remaining time near a wall increased from 15F to 20F.
- Flare Anger: Adjusted the wall-side push detection, and fixed an issue where the second and subsequent hits would whiff when back attack. Expanded the hitbox. Increased the advantageous frame after hit by 21 frames. Allows for a safe jump at the edge of the screen.

@Kaori
- Magic Blizzard C: Projectile removal box expanded.
- Magic Blizzard D: Projectile removal box expanded. Anti-air invincibility increased from 9F to 11F. First hit attack duration increased from 2F to 4F. Second hit startup changed from 27F to 25F. Total recovery time changed from 57F to 55F. Damage changed from 40+40+40 to 40+40+60.
- Re-birth Thrust: Changed from a slide down to a standard knockback.

@Kokoa
- Close 5C: Attack duration changed from 3F to 6F.
- Bright Blink: Total recovery time changed from 70F to 60F.
- Holy Shot B: Attack startup changed from 41F to 31F. Total recovery time changed from 66F to 56F. This has been reverted to its original performance.
- Saint Wave B: Attack startup changed from 18F to 17F. Total recovery time changed from 42F to 41F.
- Shining Mirage B: Hitbox reduced. Hurtbox reduced.

@Aka
- Far 5B: Adjusted the knockback of the first hit near a wall.
- 5BB (OFF): Attack level changed to the equivalent of a C attack. Total recovery changed from 51F to 45F.
- 5C (OFF): Attack duration extended from 8F to 12F.
- Memory Engrave: Landing recovery changed from 15F to 12F.
- Beat Break (ON): Changed to hit opponents in the air. Attack level changed to the equivalent of a C attack. Total recovery changed from 51F to 45F.
- Beat Break (OFF): Changed to hit opponents in the air. Attack level changed to the equivalent of a C attack. Damage changed from 60 to 40. Attack duration extended from 2F to 5F.
- Holy Flame Prayer: Attack duration changed from 7 to 15F.
- Magic Fire Wind Formation (OFF): Expanded the hitbox.
- Air Magic Fire Wind Formation (OFF): Landing recovery increased from 15F to 12F.
- Traveling Flame (OFF): Hitbox expanded.
- Burn Sisters' Soul (ON): Knockback adjusted near walls.
- Magi Reincarnation Fire: Blowback adjusted. A safe jump is now possible with a normal jump.

@Riri
- F.H.W.W. - Flame: Attack duration increased from 3F to 6F.
- Overtake A: Attackbox expanded. Attack duration increased from 2F to 4F.
- Overtake Satellite: Can now be canceled from the final frame of Overtake A. Attack duration increased from 4F to 8F.

@Hanabi
- Momentum Reading: Input changed from D to A+B(W). Gauge gain on whiff reduced to 0.
- Bet Point Shot: Minimum guaranteed damage increased to 50%.
- Magi Bet Point Shot: Minimum guaranteed damage changed to 50%.

@Marianne
- Youth Delusion Fight Life: Damage increased from 90+50 to 90+50.
- Shining Wave B: Increased the hit stop on the first hit. Adjusted the knockback. Damage increased from 80+60 to 80+80.
- Magi Shining Wave: Adjusted the push detection.
- Holy Call Shield: Damage increased from 160 to 120.
- Prismatic Emitter: Added a new move. Command: ↓+ABC.

@Iko
- 5C: Adjusted knockback. Expanded the hitbox forward. Fixed an issue where projectiles would sometimes sink into the ground after being returned.
- Thrust Upper: Changed attack startup from 14F to 13F. Changed total recovery from 40F to 39F.
- Drive Bullet B: Added the ability to fine-tune the trajectory by pressing the lever.
- Lightning Strike Method B: Damage increased from 100 to 120.
- Bump you!: The hitbox has been expanded when the attack hits the ground.
- Exciting Double Swing: Damage increased from 120 + fixed 120 to 120 + fixed 140.
- Magi Exciting Double Swing: Damage increased from 120 + fixed 120 + fixed 90 to 120 + fixed 140 + fixed 90. The opponent's landing point has been changed from the center of the screen to the edge of the screen.
- Twin Lightning: Minimum guaranteed damage increased to 50%.
- Magi Twin Lightning: Minimum guaranteed damage increased to 50%.
- -RYDEEN- Song of the ACE: Damage increased from 120 + fixed 360 to 80 + fixed 400.

@Invi
- Cool Gauge: The recovery amount is now doubled while moving forward.
- Dash: Increased forward speed.
- Demon Magic: Changed to incorporate inertia.
- Neid Kugel: Overall recovery time changed from 34F to 30F. Fixed an issue where there was no combo start adjustment.
- Demon Edge A: Adjusted the knockback. Hop JA > aerial Lichtblitz C can now be connected from cross-up, making it easier to extend combos.
- Demon Edge B: Adjusted the knockback.
- Sturmflut B: Adjusted the knockback.

@Dia
- New Generation Urban Pop: Fixed an issue where the move would fire accidentally when a forward input was used.
- 5C: Changed to stop when approaching the opponent.
- Sloth, Like Water: Can now be canceled into Far 5B, Fierce Conqueror Thrust, and Demon Magic B before they are activated.
- Sloth, Like Crocodile: Added as a new move. The command is A+B during Sloth, Late Water.
- Piggyback and Cuddling A: Changed the duration of the throw hit detection from 1F to 3F. The detection range has been increased. The throw invincibility time has been increased from 7F to 9F.
- Piggyback and Cuddling B: Changed the duration of the throw hit detection from 1F to 3F. The detection range has been increased. The total recovery time has been increased from 23F to 25F.
- Magi Piggyback and Cuddling: Increased the detection range.
- Magi Demon Edge (Ground): Added a slamming strike to the first hit. The total recovery time has been increased from 52F to 54F. Damage has been changed from 140*2 to 80+120*2. The minimum guaranteed damage of the shock wave has been increased to 50%.
- Magi Demon Edge (Air): Damage changed from 80+140*2 to 80+120*2. The minimum guaranteed damage of the shock wave portion has been changed to 50%.
- Bull Rush Blue Break Flash: Now limited to one hit per combo.
- Cruel Bull Attack: Now limited to one hit per combo.

@Kamisaman
- Dress Possibility: The standby time after use has been increased from 120F to 180F.
- Normal Moves: When Dress Possibility is maintained, moves that use Dress Possibility now deal increased damage according to their enhancement level.
- 2C: The knockback has been adjusted according to their enhancement level.
- JC: The knockback has been adjusted.
- EPR Channel (Podolski): The potential is now recovered when teleporting to a Dress Possibility location.
- F-K Dressed State (T) Derived EPR Channel: Fixed an issue where the dash continued even when inputting a forward and downward direction simultaneously.
- F-K Dressed State (H): Now limited to one use per jump.
- F-K Dressed State (H) A: The minimum duration has been increased from 90F to 120F.
- Magi F-K Dressed State (H): Now limited to one hit per combo.
- Heisenberg-Dirac-Schrödinger Image: Overall recovery time reduced from 56 frames to 42 frames.

@Hoshina Amasawa
- Far 5A: Reduced dash inertia.
- Close 5B: Reduced dash inertia. Dash detection distance is now consistent with normal.
- Shooting Star: Fixed an issue where the latter half of the move could be canceled into Troubled Lamb.

@Suguru Oikawa
- Spearfishing B: Adjusted knockback when a follow-up move does not occur on hit.

@Nemesis
- Updated AI.
- Delonix Regia A: Fixed an issue where the first hit would sometimes not trigger.
- Despair Anger: Adjusted the push detection near walls to fix an issue where the second and subsequent hits would slip through when hitting an opponent in the back.
- Saint Anger: Adjusted the push detection near walls to fix an issue where the second and subsequent hits would slip through when hitting an opponent in the back.
- Shibuya Destiny: Added as a boss-only skill.

notes.title: MGCMCE ver2.90 Update Contents
notes.content:
@All
- The common ending has been updated, and you can now see ENVY's new illustration by official illustrator Akoto. [url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/840873/view]The crowdfunding project[/url] is also running until July 7th, so please support us.
[url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/840873/view][img]https://static.camp-fire.jp/uploads/editor_uploaded_image/image/4512837/4f2a1c99371051c986cf5fdfc679a79d.png?ixlib=rails-2.1.4&fit=max&auto=format[/img][/url]
- Changed so that you can continue playing against arcade intrusion characters.
- Relaxed the conditions for arcade intrusion characters to appear from straight wins up to the fifth match to no continues up to the fifth match.
- A new character, "Nemesis," has been added only as an arcade intrusion character before playable. She will appear if you Raise the Bond/Karma at least five times during the arcade.
[previewyoutube=mbYF-IE44H4;full][/previewyoutube]
- The condition for "Kamisaman" to intrude into the arcade has been changed so that he will appear if you have not Raise the Bond/Karma at least five times during the arcade.

@Kaori
- Water Devotion: Expanded the attack box in all directions. Changed so that the opponent floats high above the ground on hit.
- Water Protection: Expanded the attack box in all directions.
- 5C (Beast form): Granted upper body invincibility from 1-14F. Expanded the attack box for the second hit downward. Reduced overall recovery by 8F.
- 2B (Beast form): Expanded the attack box downward. Now possible to follow up on a knocked down opponent.
- Maiden Wing (Beast form): Granted upper body invincibility from 1-14F.
- Ice Thrust B (Beast form): Removed the hit limit from close-range attacks.

@Ira
- Rage state: When defeated while in Rage state, the remaining Rage Gauge has been changed to 0.

@Dia
- Command List: A description error has been fixed.
- 5B (Mad Bull Mode): The hitbox has been expanded forward.
- Demon Edge A: The frame difference when guarding has been changed to -2F. On hit, it remains the same at +2F.
- Demon Edge B (Ground/Air): The rear attack box has been reduced when landing. When guarding, it can no longer be followed up Sloth Like Water. Changed so that the first hit when descending does not hit opponents in a crouching state.

@Avarin
- Mycotoxic Gas No.80: Fixed an issue where the move would sink into the ground when canceled from Demon Magic.
- Babel Variant No. 13 MC: Fixed an issue where the move would sink into the ground when canceled from Demon Magic.

@Sperbia
- 2C: The attack box has been expanded downward.

@Kamisaman
- Flux Evasion: Adjusted transparency to make the direction of movement visible.

@Hoshina
- 2B: Slowed down the timing at which the attack hit extends upwards. Changed the knockback effect when the opponent is hit continuously in the air.
- I'll blow up your ankles: Adjusted the knockback effect. A safe jump is possible with normal jump and urban jump. Can now be canceled with magi skill or higher.
- Lafite Arrow Variant: Changed to stop when it passes over the opponent. Changed to a two-stage attack. The second stage will lift the opponent high if it hits.
- Lafite Arrow Mk-II -Stray Sheep-: Added a one-hit limit during combos. Added a unique correction to subsequent follow-up attacks.

notes.title: EVO JAPAN 2025 side event exhibition! & ver2.81 update
notes.content:
The MGCMCE side event exhibit and dates have been decided for EVO JAPAN 2025, to be held at Tokyo Big Sight.
The event will start at 10:00 on Friday, May 9th.
The first half will be a demo session, with the tournament scheduled to begin at 13:00.
In addition, for beginners and those who were unable to attend, a friendly match will be scheduled to begin at 17:00.

We plan to distribute stickers drawn by the official illustrator to everyone, and we will also have luxurious prizes for the top winners. Please come and participate!

You can watch the broadcast from the Discord event below on our Magicami Fighting Game Club's Discord.
Registration for the tournament is currently being accepted at Tonamel below.
We also welcome on-site walk-ins.
[url=https://www.youtube.com/live/jfOTY_76eWQ]https://www.youtube.com/live/jfOTY_76eWQ[/url]
[url=https://discord.gg/A2WVrTAvbg?event=1360832326803652821]https://discord.gg/A2WVrTAvbg?event=1360832326803652821[/url]
[url=https://tonamel.com/competition/ygfgB]https://tonamel.com/competition/ygfgB[/url]


Also, prior to the event, we released version 2.81, which fixed several known bugs that had been reported.
The fixes are as follows:

@Iroha
- Raise the Bond: Fixed an issue where the potential gauge was filling up twice as much.
- Brave Slashes: Fixed an issue where the lower body invincibility was incomplete.

@Dia
- Magi Demon Edges: Expanded the hitbox for the second hit so that it will hit regardless of the bounding situation. Changed so that the second hit will only hit opponents who are in a defeated or guarding state.

notes.title: MGCMCE ver2.80 update contents
notes.content:
[Overall adjustment]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44584725/7b6aea1cc3f017049aaafbb56f72027488053d27.png[/img]
- Added new free DLC character "James Jenkins". When you want to use him, [b]you can change the character by pressing the D or W button while hovering over Eriza Yukifune.[/b]
- Added new stage "Nightclub".
- Improved the visibility of the cursor on the character selection screen.
- [b]Changed so that 100% possibility gauge is given at the start of the match.[/b]
- Changed so that a dash appears in Neutral D. For forward roll (Flux Evasion), you need to input the forward direction.
- New Generation Urban Pop: A new system that can be used by 2D on the ground. Automatically performs a pop or urban pop depending on the distance to the opponent. Basically, it has the same performance as normal pop and urban pop, but effects are added, and mid-air Flux Evasion cannot be used. It is also possible to cancel the attack and use it by consuming 100% of the possibility gauge.
- Counter Stance: Added effect. The attack attribute has been raised to the equivalent of magi-cami skills. Penetrates some armor and counter techniques.
- Flux Evasion (guard cancel): Added effect. Added time stop. The overall advantage/disadvantage time remains the same, but it becomes easier for both players to react to their next actions.
- Various D skills: Changed to correspond to simple commands with X+D or Y+D. With the addition of new generation urban pop, some commands have been changed.
- Raise the Bond/Raise the Karma: Changed the possibility gauge to rise gradually during the action, instead of at the same time as the occurrence. The total increase of possibility gauge is remain at 20%.

@Iroha
- Various Saint Blaze: Increased acceleration when falling.
- Saint Blaze B: Changed to turn towards the opponent when landing.
- Saint Blaze Drake Buster: Removed the hit limit for normal ground attacks after a counter hit.
- Fire Thrust A: Adjusted the knockback on hit and block. Adjusted the hit stop when hitting in the air and extended the advantageous time. It is now easier to follow up with aerial combos.
- Magi Fire Thrust: Changed so that the attracting effect will occur even when there is contact from the 4th hit onwards.

@Kaori
- Magic Blizzard: Changed so that Saint Water Stock does not accumulate on normal hits. Saint Water Stock accumulates when turning into beast mode, erasing projectiles, and establishing Magi-death.
- Re-birth Thrust: Changed so that Saint Water Stock accumulates.
- Magi Re-birth Thrust: Changed so that 2 Saint Water Stock can be accumulated. Changed so that if you hit while in beast mode and Saint Water Stock is at max, the black body will increase.

@Seira
- Unexpectedly I can do...! : Changed the command to 2AB.
- Dark Wave Attacks: Expanded the projectile removal box. Extended the duration of the projectile removal box. The gauge now increases when the projectile is removed.
- Dark Wave Attack B: Changed so that it deals wire damage on counter hit. Changed the attack level to the equivalent of a C attack. Expanded the knockback when guarding. Expanded the knockback near walls. Changed so that it also moves forward when canceled from Close 5B and Close 5C.
- Magi Focus Rejection: Can now be canceled from Dark Wave Attack B. If near a wall, it can be followed up by an additional attack.
- Shattered Swan: Changed so that it does not slip through the opponent.

@Kokoa
- Close 5B: Damage changed from 50 to 60.
- Far B: Damage changed from 40 to 50.
- Heilige Flut Command changed to 3D.
- Holy Shot: Cancellable timing changed.
- Stern Blitz A: Added a one-hit limit during combos. This hit limit does not apply during the speed-up buff.
- Holy Light Heavy Crush: Changed so that the bounce is the same as a normal hit, even when it hits with a down follow-up attack. Damage changed from 160 + Fall 40 to 140 + Fall 60.
- Holy Light Combo Crush: Changed so that the bounce is the same as a normal hit, even when it hits with a down follow-up attack. Damage changed from 160 + Fixed 60 + Fall 80 to 160 + Fixed 80 + Fall 80.

@Akisa
- Beat Break (cancel version): Removed the hit limit for ground normal attacks after hitting during the speed-up buff.
- Air Protection: Can now be canceled from Beat Break. Made to counter Magi-Death. (Can receive anti-air Magical Death, but cannot give Magi-Death against throws.)
- Air Protection D: Changed landing recovery from 26 to 12 frames. Guarding when canceling from Beat Break or a sustained hit gives you advantageous frames.
- Accel Smash B: Adjusted the knockback when hitting the ground.
- Black Shot: Fixed an issue where you could whiff-cancel before the projectile was generated.

@Ao
- Far BB: Fixed a bug where the beginning could be canceled with a push-up.
- Bladeless Sword: Changed from a command normal to a special skill. Compatible with simple commands.
- Beat Break: Expanded the hitbox upwards. Attack duration changed from 2 to 4 frames. Total frames changed from 38 to 36 frames.
- Ice Sisters' Soul B: Changed attack start from 31 to 29 frames. Duration changed from 10 to 16 frames. Total frames shortened from 54 to 52 frames.

@Aka
- 5BB (OFF): Increased forwarding speed.
- 5C (ON): Changed duration from 20 to 22 frames. Reduced frames after attack by 2 frames. Increased attack level to C attack equivalent. Changed to pull opponent in if latter part makes contact. Added juggle.
- Beat Break: Increased forwarding speed.
- Holy Flame Prayer: Changed command to C+D.
- Burn Sisters' Soul A (ON): The projectile removal box has been extended by 12 frames.
- Burn Sisters' Soul B (ON): The projectile removal box has been extended by 12 frames to eliminate any gaps before the projectile's occurrence.
- Magi Burn Sisters' Soul (ON): The projectile removal box has been extended by 12 frames to eliminate any gaps before the projectile's occurrence. Damage changed from 60*4+160 to 72*4+192.
- Burn Sisters' Soul D: Now supports simple commands. Hit stop has been adjusted. Can now be canceled by Magi Skills. Added projectile removal box.
- Magic Fire Wind Assault Formation: Now supports simple commands.
- Magic Fire Wind Assault Formation (OFF): Changed so that the hitbox appears for at least 1 frame even if the hairpin is touching a wall.
- Magic Fire Wind Formation (ON): The hairpin placed by this technique will no longer stop attacking even if Aka or hairpin get hit until it is retrieved.
- Air Magic Fire Wind Assault Formation: Added as a new technique. Command is 214D in the air.
- Air Magi Magic Fire Wind Assault Formation: Added as a new technique. Command is 214C in the air.
- Traveling Flame B (OFF): Reduced total recovery time by 10 frames on hit.
- Traveling Neon: Command changed to 2AB.
- Reincarnation Fire: Fixed the positional relationship with the opponent on hit. Adjusted the knockback. 5C (ON) will overlap with the duration, and jump attacks with Pop and Urban Pop will be safe jump.

@Eriza
- JB: Can now be canceled into Air Magi Break Volt.
- JC: Can now be canceled into Air Magi Break Volt.

@Riri
- Drive Bullet A: Changed the timing for canceling to only when the projectile comes into contact.

@Hanabi
- Jump: Expanded the hurtbox and unified it for forward and backward jumps.
- Backstep: Expanded the hurtbox.
- 2B: Removed the super low stance and made it a normal upper body invincible attack.
- JA: Expanded the hurtbox.
- JB: Expanded the hurtbox.
- JC: Expanded the hurtbox.
- Thrust Upper: Removed upper body invincibility. Fixed a bug that allowed a whiff to be cancelled.
- Momentum Reading: Changed the duration so that it only hits opponents who are in knockback on the ground. Changed the attack level to the equivalent of an A attack.
- Various Cynical Bets: Removed upper body invincibility at the start of the attack. Expanded the hurtbox. Removed lower body invincibility when landing. Changed the attack attribute when landing to a projectile judgment.
- Curse Bullet A: Startup changed from 40 to 26F. Duration changed from 120 to 16F. Total recovery changed from 59 to 48F. Trajectory changed.
- Curse Bullet B: Changed the randomness of the movement speed. Changed so that the projectile does not go too high to the top of the screen. Duration changed from 120 to 180F.
- Magi Curse Bullet: Duration changed from 300 to 360F.
- Magi Bet Point Shot: If you cancel from Momentum Reading and the opponent is in a high position, you will no longer need to delay cancel and Hanabi will automatically wait for the opponent to fall to the certain height.

@Marianne
- Youth Delusion Fight Life: Adjusted blowback and bounce. Fall damage changed to fixed damage.
- Memory Engrave / Full Power * Otaku Life: Damage changed from 80 to 100.
- Light Wave B: Damage changed from 80+40 to 80+60.
- Zanku Shining Wave: Changed the command to 3D.

@Iko
- Far 5A: Changed the motion. Adjusted the hitbox and hurtbox.
- Close 5B: Fixed an issue where the guard point was too large. Expanded the hitbox.
- Far 5B: Expanded the hitbox.
- Magi Lightning Strike Method: Expanded the hitbox forward.
- Bump You!: Added upper and projectile counter judgement from 6-15F. Automatically cascades into Killer Punch when a counter is successful.
- Bump You! D: Deleted.
- Killer Punch: Expanded the hitbox upwards. Extended duration from 6F to 10F. Changed attack attribute to projectile judgment.
- Drive Bullets: Adjusted the push judgment near walls.

@Luxuria
- Crimson Grave (Movement): Changed the command to 3D.
- Crimson Grave: Changed so that it is no longer necessary to hold down the D button when adjusting movement direction.
- Down Fall: Adjusted the bounce height.
- Down Fall A: Adjusted the knockback.
- Down Fall B: Damage changed from 60 to 80. Changed so that a counter hit will result in a slam down.
- Down Fall C: Damage changed from 80 to 100. Expanded the hitbox backwards. Reduced the hurt box. Changed so that a counter hit or a cross-up hit will result in a slam down.
- Magi Demon Edge: Expanded the hitbox. Fixed the opponent's position on hit. Changed so that it turns towards the opponent. Enable the first hit to follow-up the down opponent.
- Magi Bloody Scream: Enable the 1st to 6th hits to follow-up the down opponent.
- True Vampire Ancestors: Reduced the overall recovery time by 32 frames when the attack is successful.

@Gula
-Meat Slicer: Changed the animation when a Magi-Death occurs, so that the blessing of meat increases.

@Invi
- Far 5A: Reduced overall recovery time by 2 frames.
- Far 5B: Expanded the hitbox forward. Reduced overall recovery time by 2 frames.
- JB: Expanded the hitbox backward.
- Neid Feger: Changed to projectile detection.
- Various Neid Kugels: Changed the muzzle flash part to projectile detection as well. Fixed an issue where the projectile part was treated as a special move.
- Demon Magic: Reduced overall recovery time by 1 frame.
- Neid Drache: Adjusted the blowback. Changed it to slow down when approaching the opponent.
- Neid Drache (cancel version): Damage changed from 40 to 80. Adjusted the blowback. Changed it to slow down when approaching the opponent.
- Demon Edge A: Expanded the hurt box.
- Der Freischutz: Changed so that the cool gauge is not consumed when activated. There is no change in the fact that the number of ricochets of projectiles depends on the remaining amount of cool gauge.

@Ira
- Auto Rush Combo C: Fixed an issue where Raging Fury was activated even in Rage mode. The route to Rage mode is Close 5C > Far 5C > Komazawa Awaking.
- Close 5C: Adjusted the blowback when hit in the air. Total recovery reduced by 4 frames. You can now gain +1 frame even guarded.
- Far 5C: Adjusted the blowback when hit in the air. Expanded the attack judgment of the second hit. Changed the bounce when following up on a downed opponent to be the same as a normal hit.
- 2BB: Fixed an issue where it was possible to cancel the attack immediately after it was started.
- Aeon Reaching Heaven B: Changed the attack attribute of the first hit to be a projectile.
- Inferno Slash B: Fixed an issue where the second hit would slip through if it hit an opponent facing away.
- Aria of Wrath: Fixed an issue where the attack would enter Rage mode without consuming the rage gauge after the move if the rage gauge reached 10 with the previous action.

@Dia
- 2B: The super low stance judgment has been removed, and it is now a normal upper body invincible attack.
- 5C: Can now be canceled into Air Magi Demon Edge.
- Flux Counter: Can no longer be activated by canceling from a normal move.
- Sloth, Like Water: Changed the command to 3D.
- Sloth, Like Water derivative move: Added a hurtbox 6F just before the end of the move.
- Sloth, Like Cow: Can now be canceled into various Magi Skills and Mother's Quake.
- Sloth, Like Otter: Removed movement distance adjustment using directional keys.
- Fierce Conqueror Thrust: Can now be canceled into Magi Skills or higher.
- Demon Magic C: Removed lower body invincibility before the attack occurs.
- Ghelte Engrave: Expanded the hurt box.
- Fierce Bull Fortitude Slash B: Adjusted the blowback when hitting the ground.

@Avarin
- 5B: Reduced knockback when hitting the ground.
- 5C: Changed so that the Madness Grace buff is granted when Magi-Death is successful.
- Scototactic Parasitic Fungus(Opponent): Changed command to 2AB. Reduced hitbox. Changed total recovery from 52 to 60F.
- Paralytic Spine No. 4A: Expanded hitbox. Increased forward speed. Adjusted knockback. Easier to connect subsequent combos.
- Paralytic Spine No. 4B: Expanded hitbox. Adjusted knockback.
- Mycotoxic Gas No.80: Changed to maintain inertia.
- Demon Edge B: Changed so that it will not land before attack even when released at the lowest midair.
- Babel Variant No.13 MC: Changed to maintain inertia. Expanded hitbox.
- Special Enhancer No.28 FX: Changed the number of increased Madness Grace buffs from 2 to 1.
- Magi Special Enhancer No.28 FX: Changed the number of increased Madness Grace buffs from 4 to 2.

@Superbia
- Far 5B: Can now be canceled into Magi skills and Magi-Cami skills other than Magi Gardienne.
- The Chivalienne: Added as a new move. Command is C during a normal ground move. It's a counter wire attack.

notes.title: MGCMCE ver2.50 season2
notes.content:

@Kaori

@Adjustment Guidelines and Future Plans
　In this update, we have added a new character, Hoshina Amasawa, and adjusted the overall character balance in slightly higher ranks. Also, as an overall policy, we are making it easier to deal with projectiles and decreasing the number of situations that attacks and combos are one-sidedly crushed.
　We are also working to improve convenience, such as adjusting auto-rush combos, to reflect user requests.
　Currently, the command list and other UI elements are in both English and Japanese, but we have succeeded in changing the victory screen subtitles to Japanese. We are attempting this as a preliminary step to separate the English and Japanese versions for each regions in the future.
　In the future, we plan to add new moves and a new system based on character songs and visual books' data. We also plan to add one or more additional DLC characters depending on the status of the official offline version of Magicami, which is scheduled to be released in September 2024.

- Magi burn Sisters Soul (ON): Modified to pass through normal projectiles.

@Eriza
- Auto Rush Combo: The route when the opponent is in the air has been changed to 5A>Far A>Break Bolt A.
- 2B: Increased overall stiffness.
- A Piece of Sake! : 5C is treated as a extra move. Changed the motion. The hitbox has been expanded forward and contracted upward. Increased overall stiffness. Can now be canceled with magi skill or higher.
- JC: Removed the enhancement with flower stock and separated it as a separate technique.
- Chaser! : Added as a new technique. The command is C+D when you have flower stock.
- Kirlian Key System: Expanded throw distance. If you hold C, it will automatically derive to 5C.
- Various Break Bolts: The invincibility of the upper body before the outbreak was restored.
- Spark Spear B: No longer hits consecutively as a combo. The throwing distance has been expanded.
- Chain Lightning A: Expanded throw distance.
- Various types of Inevitable Lightning: Hitbox has been expanded. Expanded the hurtbox.

@Riri
- Auto Rush Combo: The route when the opponent is in the air has been changed to 5A>Far A>Far B>Drive Bullet A.

@Marianne
- Auto Rush Combo: The route has been changed to 5A>Far A>Far B>Drive Bullet A.
- Far B: Hitbox has been expanded forward.
- Near 2C: Added as a new technique.
- Holy Zone B: Now can be canceled upon hit.
- Various Shining Waves: The attack level has been raised to the same level as C attack. Changed the behavior on hit. Adjusted the collision detection near walls.
- Shining Wave D: Added as a new technique. The command is 4 charge 6D.
- Maji Shining Wave: Changed the generation from 13F to 17F. Damage changed from 200 to 160. Adjusted the collision detection near walls.
- Holy Light Thaumaturgy: Adjusted blowback.
- Holy Call Shield: Hitbox has been expanded downward.
- Maji Holy Light Thaumaturgy: Corrected an issue where it was not possible to cancel from Holy Call Shield.
- Full power * Otaku life: Expanded the range it takes to complete.

@Luxuria
- Fool's Rose Garden: Modified to pass through normal projectiles. Fixed an issue when counterbalanced with a projectile, the effect would shift even if it did not hit the opponent.

@gula
- 2A: Damage changed from 25 to 15. Changed the motion.
- Far B: We have created a route to flux evasion and Pride of Gluttony.
- Innocent smile: The motion has been changed.
- Back dash: Integrated with  Pride of Gluttony and treated as a extra move.
- Pride of Gluttony: Can now be used up to two times during one jump.
- Gelte Engrave: Damage changed from 60 to 40.
- Gelte Tenderizer: Added as a new technique. The command is A+B while Gelte Engrave. This is a special technique for down pursuit.
- Magi Meat Shot: Projectiles no longer go off-screen.
- Various Snack Party : Can also be used on the ground.
- Magi Karaage in the Pocket: The time stop has been extended. Added a cancellation route from the low-altitude Snack Party.

@Invi
- 5C: Reduced the downward hitbox.
- Various types of Sturmflut: The motion has been changed. Expanded hitbox. Expanded hurtbox.
- Aerial Lichtblitz A: Made it a overhead attack and slide down. It is now possible to chase down.
- Aerial Lichtblitz C: Made critical wire.

@Ira
- Fury Gauge: Removed the enhancement of each technique at 7-9.
- Far B: The motion has been changed. Adjusted the blowback.
- Far BB: Added as a new technique.
- 2B: Forced standing technique.
- 2BB: Added as a new technique.
- 5C: Added chain route to far C or 2C.
- Fury Reaching Heaven A: Extended anti-air invincibility time.
- Fury Reaching Heaven B: Damage increases according to the amount of fury gauge.
- Magi Fury Reaching Heaven : Added cancel route from Magi Demon Edge.
- Various types of Aeon Reaching Heaven: Adjusted the collision detection at the edge of the screen. The projectile now stops when it passes the opponent.
- Aeon Reaching Heaven B: Added a hit judgment at the beginning of appearance and a projectile elimination judgment. Slowed down the generation of projectiles. The damage will now increase depending on the amount of fury gauge.
- Magi Aeon Reaching Heaven: Added projectile elimination judgment. Fixed the opponent's X coordinate when hit.
- Inferno Slash B: Damage increases according to the amount of fury gauge.
- Demon Edge B: Damage increases according to the amount of fury gauge.
- Various types of Raging Fury: Instead of unblockable attack, they are now guardable attacks. It is now possible to chase down. When blocked, it will enter a special guard crush state and have a recovery advantage of +3. When activated using a gauge, Komazawa Awakening will hit continuously.
- Rage mode: The duration will vary depending on the amount of fury gauge when the Raging Fury is activated. It will now be canceled when the fury gauge reaches 0 instead of the remaining physical strength. Removed super armor. When activated using a gauge, all 1 gauge Magi skills can now be used without consuming potential.
- Various types of Komazawa Awakening: Fixed a bug where the lock could come off.
- Aria of Wrath: Modified to pass through normal projectiles.

@Dia
- 2A: Hitbox has been reduced downward. Reduced overall stiffness.
- Far B: Changed juggle from 3 to 5.
- Fierce Conqueror Thrust: Added as a new technique. The command is to hold far B. During charging, it serves as an upper body guard point and slides down. The maximum charge is an attack that cannot be blocked, and it will go into mad bull mode.
- Back dash: Added invincibility to feet. The start of the move is now judged as mid-air, allowing it to be used as a normal back step.
- Sloth, Like Water: The techniques and timing that can be derived into this technique have been greatly increased.
- Sloth, Like Hemp: Added as a derivative technique from Sloth, Like Water The command is A in 2D.
- Sloth, Like Cow: Hitbox has been expanded. Changed blowback. I set the command to B in 2D. Made it impossible to cancel into Sloth, Like Water. I created a special route that allows you to cancel into Cruel Bull Attack when it hits.
- Demon Magic C (Sloth, Like Otter): Added as a derivative technique from Sloth, Like Water. The command is C in 2D.
- Cruel Bull Alteration A: Reduced overall stiffness.
- Aerial Demon Edge A: The lower attack derived from holding down A has been removed. Sloth, Like Hemp becomes an alternative attack.

@Avarin
- 5C: Reduced knockback. Shortened duration.
- 2C: Expanded hurtbox upward after the attack ends. Shortened duration. Rear hitbox has been reduced.
- Demon Edge B: Expanded the hurtbox. Reduced the time it takes to pass through opponents. Attacks against opponents who are not in a defeated state have been delayed by 2F and the hitbox has been reduced.
- Babel Variant No. 13: The opponent's coordinate recognition timing has became faster.
- Anti-Body No. 272: Modified so that it can pass through normal projectiles.

@Superbia
- JB: Changed the motion.
- Arc Impulse B: Changed the motion. The performance has been changed.
- The Gardienne types: Fixed an issue where the landing of Magi Demon Edge could be canceled.

@ENVY
- Magi Glint Knife: Modified to pass through normal projectiles.

@Future plans
From now on,
- Negotiations for voice recording of each character
- Creation of complete English version and complete Japanese version
- Further enhancement of stories, tutorials, etc.
- Addition of new system and new characters
will be planned.
We are considering such things. We hope that you will continue to enjoy MGCM Combat Edition and support this game and the original Magicami's work. Stay tuned!

notes.title: MGCMCE ver1.08 update
notes.content:
***Iroha
- 5C: The upper body guard point has been corrected to an appropriate position. Expanded the first hit's hitbox.
- Far C: The upper body guard point has been corrected to an appropriate position. Expanded the hitbox.
- JC: Returned the occurrence from 13f to 11f.
- Fire Thrust B: Added a pulling effect to the 1st and 2nd hits. The final hit now hits opponents on the ground.
- Magi Fire Thrust: Added a pulling effect to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd hits.
- Saint Blaze Drake Buster: Added as a new technique. The command is 214D (air OK).

***Kaori
- Far C: Removed upper body invincibility.
- Maiden Wing: Added as a new technique. The command is to hold C during far C.
- Magic Blizzard types: Saint water stock will accumulate when projectiles are deleted.
- Corrosion A: Added a pulling effect to the continuous part. Made it impossible to cancel turn acquisition when guarding. Made it impossible to cancel normally with Saint Water.
- Saint Water: When the Saint water stock is 1 or more, Superior Freeze charge can now be canceled into Saint Water with A+B.

***Seira
- 2A: Moved the hitbox downward.
- Rejection A: Reduced the hitbox of the first hit.
- Rejection B: Changed the occurrence from 7f to 9f. The continuous parts hit only the opponent in blowbackstate. Adjusted the blowback.

***Kokoa
- 2A: Damage changed from 25 to 15.
- JB: The duration of the hitbox has been reduced. Expanded the hurtbox.
- JC: Changed the occurrence of attacks against non-devouring opponents from 10f to 13f. The occurrence when incorporated into a combo does not change.
- Bright Blink: The first hit's hitbox and hurtbox have been corrected to the appropriate position. Expanded the second hit's hitbox. Fixed an issue where down pursuit was not possible.
- Holy Shot A: The hitbox has been corrected to the appropriate position.
- Sacred Wave A: Damage changed from 50 to 40.
- Sacred Wave B: Damage changed from 60 to 50.
- Sacred Wave (Move): Added as a new technique. The command is 22D.
- Shining Mirage: Expanded the hurtbox after moving. Rear hitbox has been removed.
- Magic Shining Mirage: The third hit will only hit the opponent in blowback state.
- Rising Light: Shortened the effect time of focus up.
- Holy Light Heavy Crush: The advantageous time when chasing down has been extended. Follow-up with Bright Blink is confirmed.
・Holy Light Combo Crush: The advantageous time when chasing down has been extended. Follow-up with Bright Blink is confirmed.

***Ao
- 5B: Extended the duration of the hitbox that only hits opponents in the devoured state.
- Bounced: Fixed an issue where the trigger could be canceled by throwing or using skills.
- Various Ice Sisters Souls: Fixed an issue where they could not be activated using simple commands.
- Various Horizontal Slash (Charge): The upper body guard points have been corrected to the appropriate position.

***Riri
- Magi Air Flame, Heat, Wind and Wave: Hitbox has been expanded. It hastened the occurrence.  Cancel timing from Memory engrave and Overtake B have been changed.

***Hanabi
- Curse Bullet A: Corrected so that it does not sink into the ground even when moving downward.
- Magi Curse Bullet: The reference Y coordinate of the tracking opponent has been moved upward.

***Iko
- 2A: Moved the hitbox downward.
- 2B: Expanded the hurtbox after the hitbox appears.
- 5C: Corrected the hitbox to the appropriate position.
- Continuous flux evasion: Fixed so that Pop/Urban Pop takes priority if the upper element is input after the second time.
- Thrust Upper: Lower body guard point has been corrected to the appropriate position.
- Various Lightning Strike Methods: The upper body guard points have been corrected to the appropriate position. Corrected the hitbox to the appropriate position.
- Lightning Strike Method A: Slide down even when counter hit.
- Magi Lightning Strike Method: If canceled from Lightning Strike Method, the forward distance will be increased.
- Glitter Kick: Adjusted the backward push judgment.
- Magi Bump You!: Performance has been returned to the state as of June 2023 version.
- Magi Drive Bullet: Changed the trajectory so that it hits a fixed trajectory instead of random.
- Magi Drive Bullet Knock Menu: The trajectory pattern can now be changed by pressing the button when firing the Magi Drive Bullet.

***Dia
- Front Step: Allows you to pass through the opponent during the movement.
- Cruel Bull Alteration A: Fixed a bug where anti-air invincibility was becoming shorter.

***ENVY
- Far B: Hitbox has been expanded. Increased forward distance.
- 5C: Now knocks down with a single shot. It became the juggle 5. The cancellation route to far C and 2C has been deleted. Adjusted knockback.
- 2C: Hitbox has been reduced downward and expanded forward.
- Vanity: Flux Evasion while dashing has been made independent as a special skill. The command is 3D.
- Bomb Blink "FOOL": Added as a new technique. The command is 214D.
- Aerial Glint Knife "HATE": Behavior has been changed. Added a pulling effect to the first hit.
- Magi Bomb Blink: Knockback has been adjusted.
- Aerial Naive Knives: Reduced overall time.
- Magi Glint Knife: Hitbox has been expanded. The minimum guaranteed damage has been increased to 50%. Increased overall time.
